design.acceptance: exploratory strict gate: both paired normal-approx 95% lower bounds >0, mean unique-genome gain >0, no-division zero births, >=50% paired seeds with positive functional B gain, one-sided exact sign p<0.05; otherwise not demonstrated
design.holdout: Continue a copy for 15 ticks with TASK_B reward 1, mutation frozen at 0; stress test, not unseen-task generalization
design.primary_metric: paired final viable TASK_B program carrier share, extinct=0
design.secondary_metric: paired final population under lower-reward mutation-frozen holdout
design.training: TASK_A then TASK_B; matching instruction earns 2 energy

limits: Engineered deterministic digital VM; no biological organisms or LLM self-training.
Confidence intervals describe selected seeds, not general ecosystem uncertainty.
Holdout is a reduced TASK_B reward, not a previously unseen task.
The exploratory acceptance threshold was strengthened after inspecting a 30-seed pilot; this is not preregistered confirmation.
A positive gate would show adaptation only within these rules and seeds.
